subject: info-af-b
title: INFO.AF.B.------C.FO.ACT.
description: Diagram in PCC-23, the first of two on book p339. (C)INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) is crossed with C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism). The diagram pairs the *informational* and *active* poles directly. INFO-AF-B → SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) → C-FO-ACT (the crossing); DEC (decentralization) → SOC-RT-DY in parallel. INFO-AF-B → (R)INT (the reality of intention) → PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). RE-ST (restructuralism) → GRAD (gradualism) → PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) → INFO-AF-B (a feedback loop), with PROG-CONT also → RT-DY (reality dynamics) and PROG-CONT → PR-TRS (primary transition). POL-DYM (political dynamics) → PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) runs as a sibling sub-chain. Structural argument: information affinity basis reaches composite focused activism via social reality dynamics (which is co-fed by decentralization — note the structural requirement). Real intention then produces projectional dynamics. The restructuralism→gradualism→progressional-continuance loop *feeds back* into information affinity basis, with progressional continuance also producing reality dynamics and primary transition as siblings. The diagram thus diagrams what makes restructuralism productive rather than merely captured-by-gradualism: the loop must terminate at primary transition (a real change in transition, not just gradualist continuance) and produce real intention's projectional dynamics — only then does information affinity basis reach composite focused activism via decentralized social reality dynamics.
